title: Luiza Possi Records Gospel Album at Sala São Paulo
seoTitle: Luiza Possi Records Gospel Album at Sala São Paulo
subtitle: Artist records first audiovisual album after evangelical conversion
excerpt: Luiza Possi recorded her first live gospel album at Sala São Paulo, featuring orchestra, choir, and special guests, marking the new phase of her Christian career.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Monday, September 7, 2026, Luiza Possi recorded the audiovisual album "Quando Ele me encontrou" at Sala São Paulo. The event featured an orchestra, choir, and special guests, solidifying the singer’s transition to Christian repertoire.

Luiza Possi records gospel album at Sala São Paulo

The show was held at Sala São Paulo with the support of the Orchestra and Choir of Theatro São Pedro. The recording included six original songs by the artist, as well as tracks from the album "Quero conhecer Jesus" and versions of Christian hymn favorites.

The recording process and orchestra participation

The production featured orchestral and choral arrangements, providing a richer sound for the songs. Singer Eli Soares and the group Get Worship joined the stage, expanding the sonic diversity of the project.

The transition from secular to Christian music

After announcing her evangelical conversion in March 2026, which occurred in September 2024, Luiza decided to end her secular career with the album "É Só o Amor." She describes the change as "a renunciation that had to happen" and says she now sings for Jesus without the weight of ego.

Audience reaction and significance of the change

Free tickets sold out in minutes, which the artist interprets as confirmation of the new phase. She says that, unlike previous shows, she now feels the stage is an altar of worship, easing the artistic pressure.

Next steps in the career

With the audiovisual album completed, Luiza Possi plans to continue releasing original songs and participate in religious events. She highlights that the peace she found surpasses past difficulties, citing Philippians 4:7.

With information from Folha de S.Paulo, G1.
